exercises.title: Knowledge & PM 1 — knowledge or project management?
exercises.problemHtml:
Classify each practice: Knowledge (train BAs, educate stakeholders, educate developers about the domain, define an RE process, create a glossary) or Project management (life cycle, plan the approach, estimate effort, base plans on requirements, decision makers, renegotiate commitments, manage risks, track effort, lessons learned).

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Knowledge & PM 3 — plans, estimates and risks
exercises.problemHtml:
Base project plans on requirements and refine them iteratively — early estimates from fuzzy requirements are uncertain. On agile, time-boxed iterations mean adjusting scope to fit fixed schedule and resources. Manage requirements risks: identify, document, mitigate and track them. Track the effort spent on requirements to improve future estimates.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Knowledge & PM 3 — plans, estimates and risks — answer key

1. Early estimates made from a vague vision are…Ước lượng sớm từ một tầm nhìn mơ hồ thì…
   Answer: d) highly uncertain; refine them as requirements become clearer
   Plans evolve with understanding.VI: Kế hoạch thay đổi theo hiểu biết.

2. On an agile project with a fixed release date, what is adjusted when requirements grow?Dự án agile có ngày phát hành cố định, khi yêu cầu tăng thì điều chỉnh gì?
   Answer: a) The scope delivered in the time box
   Time-boxes fix time; scope flexes.VI: Time-box cố định thời gian; phạm vi co giãn.

3. Why record the effort spent on requirements?Vì sao ghi lại công sức làm yêu cầu?
   Answer: d) To improve future estimates and judge the return on requirements work
   Data for better planning.VI: Dữ liệu để lập kế hoạch tốt hơn.

exercises.title: Knowledge & PM 4 — training and process
exercises.problemHtml:
Anyone doing BA tasks, with or without the title, needs requirements training. A documented requirements engineering process gives consistent quality and helps plan each project’s requirements tasks, schedule and resources; the PM puts requirements activities into the plan as discrete tasks.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

Ai làm việc BA cũng cần đào tạo; quy trình RE được ghi lại giúp chất lượng nhất quán và dễ lập kế hoạch.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.
